college.name: X College of Engineering and Technology
college.vision: To develop skilled professionals through quality education, innovation and research.
college.mission: To provide technical knowledge, practical learning and professional development opportunities.

admissions.eligibility: Candidates must complete 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
admissions.minimum_percentage: 45% for general category and 40% for reserved categories, subject to applicable rules.
process: Participate in the applicable entrance examination and counselling.
admissions.contact: Contact the Admissions Office for application assistance.

courses.name: Computer Science and Engineering
courses.description: Covers programming, algorithms, databases, operating systems and software development.

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
courses.description: Focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning and data science.

courses.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
courses.description: Covers electronics, communication systems, embedded systems and signal processing.

courses.name: Electrical and Electronics Engineering
courses.description: Focuses on electrical machines, power systems and electrical circuits.

courses.name: Mechanical Engineering
courses.description: Covers manufacturing, thermodynamics, machine design and engineering mechanics.

courses.name: Civil Engineering
courses.description: Covers structural engineering, construction, surveying and environmental engineering.

fees.note: All fee amounts are fictional sample figures and subject to change.

placements.internships: Students receive internship guidance and opportunities through placement activities and industry connections.
placements.eligibility: Recruitment eligibility depends on the individual company's academic and selection criteria.
placements.contact: Students can approach the Training and Placement Office.

library.description: A central library with textbooks, reference books, journals and digital learning resources.
library.timings: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday

facilities.wifi: Wi-Fi connectivity is available in academic and selected campus areas.
facilities.medical: Basic first-aid and medical assistance facilities are available on campus.
facilities.transport: College buses operate on selected routes around the city.

hostel.availability: Separate accommodation facilities are available for boys and girls.
hostel.food: Vegetarian and non-vegetarian meal options are available.
hostel.timings: Hostel entry and exit follow the hostel administration's prescribed schedule.
hostel.application: Students can apply through the Hostel Administration Office.

examinations.attendance: Students must satisfy the applicable university attendance requirements.
examinations.results: Results are published through the student examination portal.
examinations.revaluation: Students can apply for revaluation within the notified application period.

academic_calendar.note: These are indicative months, not confirmed academic dates.
